articles.title: Sophie Cunningham, Caitlin Clark respond to Fever coach Stephanie White's pregame rant - Fox News
articles.description: Caitlin Clark said she felt "sick" when fans booed Stephanie White before the Indiana Fever's 106-92 win over the New York Liberty on Tuesday.
articles.content:
